This section lists all of the students in the classroom. The colors correspond to the emotion images listed below. A gray circle indicates no use in the specified time.

This weekly view displays all of the sessions for the student in the past week. Every listed box indicates a session from that day, along with the chosen activities and total length of the session. The colors correspond to the emotion images listed below.

This section compares tool usage across the entire classroom over the past several days, weeks, and months, each with a color associated with the selected emotions. The colors correspond to the emotion images listed below. A gray circle indicates no use in the specified time.
This section lists the breakdown of coping skills used in the classroom by all students. The most used coping skill is the largest circle which appears on the left-hand side.
This section lists the breakdown of coping skills used by this student. The most used coping skill is the largest circle which appears on the left-hand side.

This section highlights patterns in your classroom. This includes detecting changes in trends of emotions (both as students and the class as a whole), noticing when the class is doing a lot of physical activity, and more.
Coming Soon: students with interesting patterns in their usage will display here.
T0 Pattern: No students highlighted (Null pattern)
This is a test pattern, which should always result in an empty list of students.
T1 Pattern: At least 1 student exists
This is a test pattern, determines if at least one student exists and then displays it.
A1 Pattern: These students have selected uncomfortable emotions many times this week.
A2 Pattern: These students have selected Scared in the past week.
A4 Pattern: Everyone in the class says they are happy today!
Your classroom has done a lot of Jumping Jacks recently. Do they need more physical activities?
A5 Pattern: These students have picked the same emotion for at least the past two days.
